ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows that the Poyang Lake Ecological Economic Zone is located from the northern to central part of Jiangxi Province, spreading around Poyang Lake and its surroundings. In the figure, cities such as Jiujiang, Nanchang, and Yingtan can be seen distributed near or within this region. The north is close to the Yangtze River, and overall it presents a distribution pattern concentrated along Poyang Lake and the main transportation and river channels. Combined further with the data in the question stem: the land of this zone accounts for about 30% of the whole province of Jiangxi, but its gross domestic product in 2008 accounted for about 60% of the whole province, and its total population accounted for about 50% of the whole province. This shows that the economic output per unit area of this zone is obviously higher than the provincial average, and the per capita economic level is also relatively high. Population in-migration is usually mainly attracted by employment opportunities and income levels, so compared with other regions within the province, the main reason this zone can better attract population in-migration is that the economy is relatively developed and employment opportunities are relatively many.
